record: K blocks of 112 bytes then a 16-byte trailer (16, K, 0, 0). A block is 9 slots of three i32 plus one trailing flag word that is only ever 0 or 1. Values are 1.19.12, divided by 4096 here. col2 is an elevation; col0/col1 are the ground plane.

THE_TRIPLES_ARE_ROOM_LOCAL.claim: the ground-plane pair is in the SAME frame and units as data/room_doorways.json, and is bounded by the room's own wall
THE_TRIPLES_ARE_ROOM_LOCAL.why_it_matters: psz-godot rings enemies around the room centre because the record was undecoded. These are drop-in room-local positions. It is also the strongest check the stride-3 reading has: a wrong stride or phase would scatter over the i32 range and respect no wall at all.

THE_COLUMNS_ARE_X_THEN_Z.answer: col0 is x and col1 is z -- the plain reading
THE_COLUMNS_ARE_X_THEN_Z.how: a savestate is a RAM snapshot, so the spawned enemies can be read straight out of one and compared against the triples. They sit on their slots EXACTLY.
THE_COLUMNS_ARE_X_THEN_Z.strength: confirmed -- exact equality at 1.19.12 precision, 50 to 0

the_refuted_door_argument.note: a previous pass concluded (z, x) from the wall_approach numbers below, calling the (x, z) sign absurd. The measurement is real; the sign was read backwards. Authored spawn points are kept away from the doorway the player enters through, so sitting further from doored walls is exactly what to expect.

THE_CONTAINMENT_ROUTE_IS_STILL_REFUTED.verdict: CONTAINMENT is inconclusive -- but see wall_approach(), which settles it
THE_CONTAINMENT_ROUTE_IS_STILL_REFUTED.why: every extracted room is a single 44x44 cell, symmetric in x and z, so CONTAINMENT scores both assignments identically. That refutation stands and is why the footprint route was abandoned. What it does not refute is door geometry: an opening is not symmetric with a solid wall, and wall_approach() reads exactly that asymmetry.
THE_CONTAINMENT_ROUTE_IS_STILL_REFUTED.answer: col0 = z and col1 = x -- see wall_approach()
